# BornClock

BornClock is a free Vedic astrology and birthday site, in English, Hindi and eight more Indian languages (Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi). Its Vedic engine computes sidereal (Lahiri) charts and checks them against the Swiss Ephemeris and other published sources; every comparison, with counts and dates, is listed at https://bornclock.com/accuracy/. Every astrology term is explained in plain language, remedies start with free options, and predictions never claim certainty. The site also has science-backed longevity tools (WHO, GBD 2024, UN WPP data), celebrity birthday twins (Wikidata), numerology and Western/Chinese zodiac.

## Vedic Astrology (free tools)

- https://bornclock.com/kundali/ — Free Kundli (birth chart): North, South and East Indian charts; all 16 divisional charts (D1–D60); Vimshottari Dasha to 5 levels (Maha to Prana), Yogini and Jaimini Chara Dasha; Shadbala; Ashtakavarga with Prastarashtakavarga; KP tables; Bhava Chalit; Avkahada Chakra and Ghatak Chakra; yogas and doshas with remedies; ayanamsa choice (Lahiri, Raman, KP, Sayana)
- https://bornclock.com/kundali-match/ — Kundli matching: 36-guna Ashtakoota, South Indian 10 porutham (Tamil and Kerala rules) and Papasamyam, Manglik check
- https://bornclock.com/prashna/ — Prashna (horary) by the KP method: answer one question from a number 1–249 or the moment asked; no birth time needed
- https://bornclock.com/rashifal/ — Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly Rashifal by Moon sign
- https://bornclock.com/panchang/ — Daily Panchang for 50 cities (tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise, Rahu Kaal, Choghadiya)
- https://bornclock.com/dasha-calculator/ — Vimshottari Dasha calculator
- https://bornclock.com/sade-sati/ — Shani Sade Sati check with dates
- https://bornclock.com/manglik/ — Manglik (Mangal) dosha check
- https://bornclock.com/lal-kitab/ — Lal Kitab Kundli and remedies
- https://bornclock.com/varshphal/ — Varshphal (Tajik annual chart)
- https://bornclock.com/muhurat/ — Muhurat finder
- https://bornclock.com/nakshatra/ — The 27 nakshatras explained
- https://bornclock.com/planet-in-house/ — Every planet in every house, explained
- https://bornclock.com/festivals/ — Hindu festival dates, with 2027 pages and muhurat times for 10 cities
- https://bornclock.com/glossary/ — Plain-language glossary of Vedic astrology terms
- https://bornclock.com/accuracy/ — How BornClock checks its calculations: dated comparisons against Swiss Ephemeris, PyJHora, ProKerala, Drik Panchang, AstroSage and FuturePoint

## Celebrity Birthdays, Zodiac and Rashi (3,043 profiles)

- https://bornclock.com/celebrity/[slug] — One profile per famous person (3,043; Indian and global): date of birth, age, Western Sun sign, Vedic Moon sign (Rashi) and Nakshatra, Chinese zodiac, Life Path number. The Moon sign is computed from the birth DATE with the same sidereal engine as the Kundli; when the Moon changed sign that day both signs are shown, because the birth time is usually not on public record. Example: https://bornclock.com/celebrity/virat-kohli
- https://bornclock.com/todays-birthdays — Famous birthdays today (the list changes every India day; each name links to a profile)
- https://bornclock.com/todays-birthdays/india — "Aaj kiska birthday hai": Indian celebrity birthdays today
- https://bornclock.com/celebrity-birthday — Celebrity birthday twin finder (who shares my birthday)
- https://bornclock.com/born-on/[month]-[day] — One page per date (366): zodiac sign, the Sun's degree and decan, cusp notes, birthday personality and the famous people born that day. Example: https://bornclock.com/born-on/november-5
- https://bornclock.com/born-on/[month]-[day]/india — Indian celebrities born on a date (350 dates). Example: https://bornclock.com/born-on/september-3/india
- https://bornclock.com/zodiac/[sign]/celebrities — Famous people of each Sun sign, Indian and global (12). Example: https://bornclock.com/zodiac/leo/celebrities
- https://bornclock.com/chinese-zodiac/[year] — Chinese zodiac for every year 1924–2031: animal, element, exact Chinese New Year start and end dates, famous people born that year. Example: https://bornclock.com/chinese-zodiac/1990
- https://bornclock.com/born-in-[month] — "Born in {Month}" hubs (12): zodiac signs, birthstone, birth flowers, famous births. Example: https://bornclock.com/born-in-august
- https://bornclock.com/angel-numbers/[n] — Angel number meanings (framed as modern spiritual belief, not science). Example: https://bornclock.com/angel-numbers/1111
- https://bornclock.com/answers — Short sourced answers (zodiac sign, Moon sign, life path, generation, age on Mars, days until my birthday)

## Rhythm and Fitness (rhythm-awareness, NOT medical advice)

These pages use the classic biorhythm model as a daily reflection prompt. HONESTY POLICY (stated on every page): the three-cycle biorhythm model dates from the early 20th century and controlled research has not found it predictive; it is framed as a rhythm-awareness / check-in practice, never a prescription. No claims of performance, injury prevention, hormonal/medical effects, or weight loss. Where real science exists (consistency, chronotype, sleep) it is stated plainly and kept separate from the rhythm layer.

- https://bornclock.com/biorhythm-workout-calculator — Biorhythm workout check-in (anchor)
- https://bornclock.com/best-day-to-start-a-habit — Habit timing vs. consistency (evidence-first)
- https://bornclock.com/cycle-syncing-for-men — Rhythm awareness for everyone (circadian, not hormonal claims)
- https://bornclock.com/why-am-i-tired-some-days — Honest look at sleep, circadian rhythm, daily variation
- https://bornclock.com/best-time-to-work-out — What the science says (consistency, chronotype) + rhythm layer
- https://bornclock.com/energy-forecast — 7-day rhythm check-in (not a prediction)
